name: Broken and Battered Samophlange
summary: In the northern Barrens, Venture Company machinery lies battered after a failed inspection. The damaged samophlange must reach goblin experts in Orgrimmar, where someone may understand how it works.

sections.title: Tinkered Beyond Recognition
sections.body: The Venture Company made samophlanges for its resource work in the northern Barrens. Wenikee Boltbucket tried to inspect and modify one, adding gauges, levers, and dials to measure its stability. Her tinkering weakened the mechanism instead, leaving it battered and close to ruin. Knowing more additions might make it fail completely, she sent the fragile device to someone with factory experience.

sections.title: The Road to Orgrimmar
sections.body: Repairing the device calls for someone who has worked on Venture Company production lines. Rilli Greasygob, a former Venture employee, works at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. The battered apparatus catches the engineer's eye. Anyone who scavenges from goblin operations may seem daring, or simply foolhardy.

faq.answer: A samophlange is machinery made by the Venture Company for its industrial work in the Barrens. Few outsiders understand the secrets of its goblin engineering.

faq.q: Why is the samophlange broken and battered?
faq.answer: Wenikee Boltbucket tried to modify the samophlange with extra gauges to measure its stability. The additions weakened it and damaged its sensitive inner parts.

faq.q: Who can fix this damaged apparatus?
aliases: who do i bring this to
faq.answer: Rilli Greasygob can examine the damaged device. The former Venture Company employee works at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

faq.q: Where did this machinery originally come from?
faq.answer: The machinery came from Venture Company's drilling and extraction operations in the northern Barrens. Goblin engineers use it to power heavy extraction machinery.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see the danger in adding dials and levers to an unstable Venture Company mechanism without a schematic.
As a member of the Horde, you bring salvaged Venture Company machinery from the Barrens to Orgrimmar's goblin machine shops, where it may reveal valuable technical secrets.
